reviews.title: Wird kaputtoptimiert
reviews.text:
Meine einstige Lieblingswetter App bestach durch eine einzigartige Übersichtlichkeit. Keine andere Wetter App konnte so klar und unaufdringlich viele Wetterdetails anzeigen. Dann wurde die App immer instabiler. Es sah so aus, als wäre die Entwicklung komplett eingestellt worden. Insbesondere das Radar war verglichen mit anderen Apps pixelig und unpräzise.
Was auch immer hinter den Kulissen passiert sein mag, es lässt nur vermuten, dass der frühere Designer und die meisten Programmierer nicht mehr dabei sind. Das neue Radar wirkt billig und angeflanscht, zudem träge und ruckelig, als würde einfach eine Webseite geladen. Das Farbschema könnte vom Rest der App nicht weiter weg sein.
Zu den entfernten weiteren Karten von früher will ich mich gar nicht mehr äußern, sondern ergreife enttäuscht die Flucht zur Konkurrenz. Sehr schade!

reviews.title: Disappointed, long-term subscriber
reviews.text:
I have been a WeatherPro subscriber for many years and, unfortunately, I can no longer recommend the app in its current form.

WeatherPro was once one of the best weather applications available on iOS. The detailed forecasts, radar layers and premium features justified the subscription cost and made it a valuable tool for those who relied on accurate weather information. However, over recent months the app appears to have been steadily downgraded whilst continuing to charge subscribers for a premium service. The result is that long-term customers are paying for functionality that is either unreliable, unavailable, or simply does not work as advertised.

What is particularly disappointing is the apparent lack of transparency from the developer. Reading through recent reviews, I am clearly not alone. Numerous users report issues with premium features, radar functionality, widgets, account recognition, subscription activation and general reliability. The developer’s responses often direct users to support channels, yet the same complaints continue to appear repeatedly. (App Store)

The premium subscription is marketed as providing enhanced radar layers, 14-day forecasts, weather maps and other advanced features. (DTN Consumer) If those features are not functioning consistently, subscribers are not receiving the service they have paid for.

As a loyal customer, I feel let down. Long-term subscribers supported this app when it was one of the market leaders, yet it now feels as tho

reviews.title: Used to be good
reviews.text:
I’m extremely disappointed with how WeatherPro has declined over recent updates. What used to be an excellent weather app has become frustrating to use. Features I relied on regularly — especially the satellite imagery and weather pattern tools — either no longer work properly or have been removed altogether.

As someone who uses weather data frequently, this has seriously reduced the app’s value. To make matters worse, I contacted customer support over 5 days ago and have received no response whatsoever. That level of customer service is unacceptable for a paid subscription app.

At this stage I’m considering requesting a refund, which is something I never thought I’d say about an app I previously rated highly.

Wat een gigantische armoede en DTN moet zich rot schamen om überhaupt geld te vragen  voor een totaal verouderde app die alleen maar zeer sporadische bugfixes krijgt.

reviews.title: AVOID – No longer reliable for professional use
reviews.text:
I’ve been a Pro subscriber for many years and rely on accurate weather forecasting for agricultural work, where timing and wind speed in particular are critical. This app used to be excellent, but its reliability and overall quality have declined significantly.

The radar feature, once genuinely useful, is now a low-resolution, blocky display that offers very little practical value in real-world decision-making.

Wind forecasting is especially important in agriculture, and the app’s wind theme is genuinely helpful. Unfortunately, this is outweighed by wider issues with the app itself. Since the move to a monthly App Store subscription, the link between the paid subscription and the app breaks regularly — in my case, every month. The only workaround is to delete and reinstall the app, then reconfigure all settings from scratch. Support advised me to do this over a year ago, and the problem still hasn’t been fixed, which strongly suggests the app is no longer being properly maintained.

The app also repeatedly requests access to motion data, with no clear explanation as to why this is necessary for a weather app.

What was once a dependable professional tool is now unreliable and frustrating. I can no longer recommend it for anyone who depends on accurate forecasts for their work.
